title: incident-bot: add oncall context summaries and runbook suggestion scoring
author: Maya Patel
description:
Summary: Adds an on-call context summarization pipeline and runbook suggestion scoring to the incident-bot to improve pager triage and accelerate remediation. Motivation: on-call engineers spend time gathering context (recent deploys, error rates, recent runbook matches). This PR introduces a compact context summary attached to on-call notifications and an L1 scoring heuristic to surface the most relevant runbooks.

What this changes: - Context extractor: collects recent SLO breach excerpts, top 3 error traces (de-duplicated), last deploy metadata, and recent related alerts. Summaries are compressed to ~1-3 sentences for notification payloads. - Runbook scorer: lightweight heuristic + model-proxy scoring (fallback to keyword match) that ranks runbooks by relevance and confidence. Outputs a score and matched highlights. - Telemetry: emits metrics for suggestion CTR, suggestion accept/ignore, and measured time-to-first-action for incidents where suggestions are shown. - Config: feature-flagged rollout (incident_bot.features.oncall_context_summary) with canary_percentage and debounce window. - Docs: console docs and runbook authoring guidelines for producing high-quality matches.

Checklist: 
- [x] Context extraction and summarization implementation
- [x] Runbook scorer with fallback rules
- [x] Telemetry & dashboards (SLO toolkit events + Grafana dashboard)
- [x] Tests (unit + e2e playbook flows)
- [x] Migration/rollout plan

Testing & validation: Unit tests cover extractor edge-cases (empty traces, long stacks). Integration tests validate end-to-end suggestion surface in a simulated on-call notification. e2e playbook test exercised the suggestion and measured CTR > 0 during smoke run. Manual canary on staging with 10% traffic for 48h.

Rollout plan: enable feature for internal SRE team (10%), monitor suggestion accuracy telemetry and CTR, then increase to 50% then full roll. Backout: disable feature flag; suggestions stop being generated, no DB migration required.

Related: Linear ENG-4321 (on-call tooling improvements), SRE-1180 (reduce time-to-first-action). SUP-332 documents customer asks for runbook surfacing during alerts.

Notes: This PR is intentionally conservative about payload size (max 1KB for notification attachment). The runbook scorer is modular—future work includes ML-based reranker in a separate PR.
commits: 5 commits: refactor/context-extractor (split extractor/serializer), feat/summarizer (add summarization pipeline), feat/runbook-scorer (heuristic + proxy hook), feat/telemetry (events + dashboards), docs/runbook-guidelines
diff_snippet:
--- a/services/incident-bot/src/handlers/oncall_notify.py
+++ b/services/incident-bot/src/handlers/oncall_notify.py
@@ -42,6 +42,18 @@ def build_notification(payload):
     notification['title'] = payload.title
     # existing fields preserved
+    # attach compact context summary when enabled
+    if flags.is_enabled('oncall_context_summary', payload.team):
+        ctx = context_extractor.extract(payload.incident_id)
+        notification['context_summary'] = summarizer.summarize(ctx, max_sentences=3)
+        # attempt runbook suggestions
+        suggestions = runbook_scorer.suggest(ctx, top_k=3)
+        notification['runbook_suggestions'] = suggestions

     return notification
review_comments: Priya Singh: please add metrics for runbook clickthrough and accept/ignore — otherwise we won't be able to iterate. (resolved: added telemetry and dashboard panels)
Elias Chen: the summarizer can be noisy for long traces; suggest de-dup and prefer stackframe fingerprints. (resolved: added dedupe + fingerprinting and unit tests)
Omar Vasquez: debounce suggestions to avoid flapping on repeated low-confidence alerts — otherwise oncall spam increases. (resolved: added 5m debounce per-incident configurable window)
Maya Patel (author): replied to comments, updated tests, added staging canary and docs for runbook authors
release_notes:
Adds on-call context summaries to notifications and automated runbook suggestions (feature-flagged). Includes telemetry for suggestion CTR and dashboards. Rollout via feature flag.

Impact: opt-in behind feature flag; no DB migrations.

How to use: enable incident_bot.features.oncall_context_summary for a team, author runbooks with the new metadata fields (tags, example-alerts) to improve match quality.
